events.name: Boss Rush Mini
events.intro: Three huge wild Pokémon block the road, one behind the other, and all three are furious: eyes red, fur on end, ground torn up where they have been pacing. They are not hungry. Something has frightened them very badly.

success.text: The first one charges the moment you step forward. Three of them, one after another, and no time to breathe.
You circle wide around them, slow and careful, and follow the torn ground back the way they came. Over the next rise: cages, and nets, and a poacher camp.

events.name: The Poacher Camp
events.intro: A poacher camp: cages stacked three high, a cookfire, two men arguing over a ledger. In the cages, the young of the three angry Pokémon on the road, crying for their parents.

success.text: "Oi! Those are paid for!" The poachers grab their Poké Balls.

win.text: Freed the poachers' cages; three angry Pokémon calmed and went home.

events.name: Camp Counselor Contest
events.intro: **A camp counsellor** with a whistle and a clipboard: "Three-legged battle! You get a partner you didn't pick, and you win together or not at all!"

success.text: You draw a name out of the hat. Your partner for the day is a road trainer with a Growlithe that immediately licks your hand. "Don't let me down," they say, and grin.

win.text: Won a three-legged battle with a stranger.

events.name: Charity Match
events.intro: A banner across the square: ALL PRIZES TO THE TOWN FUND. A trainer is waiting under it, and behind them, a hand-painted thermometer showing how far the fund still has to go. It has a long way to go.

success.text: The crowd cheers you both in. Every prize from this fight goes to the town.

win.text: Won a charity match; the prize went to the town fund.

success.text: You drop ₽200 into the bucket. Someone climbs a ladder and paints the thermometer a little higher, and the whole square claps for you.

events.name: Collector's Test
events.intro: **A collector** in a coat covered in Water-type badges: "Water-type owners only. Bigger prize." He looks you up and down. "Anyone else can battle too. Normal prize."

success.text: His eyes light up when he sees your Water-type. "Now that is a proper trainer." Double prize.
"Fine, fine." He waves a hand. Normal prize.

events.name: Double Date Doubles
events.intro: **Rosa and Hal**, holding hands and looking stricken: "Our partners cancelled! The tournament starts in five minutes! Borrow my Pokémon. Please."

success.text: Rosa presses a Poké Ball into your hand. "Pikachu. She bites if you're rude." You and her Pikachu take the field together, against a pair who look very pleased about it.

win.text: Stood in for a cancelled partner at a doubles tournament.

events.name: Double Trouble
events.intro: Twins in matching scarves, finishing each other's sentences: "We battle..." "...together!" "Two against..." "...two!"

success.text: They step out side by side, and their Pokémon do too.

events.name: Eco Ranger Test
events.intro: **Ranger, Ingrid**, in a green jacket with a capture styler on her belt: "Calm them. No knockouts. A Ranger never hurts what they're protecting."

success.text: Three wild Pokémon, frightened and lashing out. Put them to sleep or wear them down, but do not let a single one faint.

win.text: Passed the Eco Ranger test without one knockout.

events.name: Gym Scout
events.intro: **A guide** leaning on the Gym town signpost, flipping a coin: "Want to know what's inside? The Leader's lead, and the ace. Everyone asks eventually."

success.text: You pay. She leans in and tells you, plainly, the first Pokémon out and the last one standing.
"Brave," she says. "Or stubborn." She goes back to flipping her coin.

events.name: Gym Trainer Practice
events.intro: **A gym trainer** in the Gym's colours steps out of a doorway: "Want to see what the leader uses? Battle me and show me you deserve to know."

success.text: They take you on with the Gym's own style.

events.name: Held-Item Gauntlet
events.intro: Four trainers in a row along the road, each holding something up: a Quick Claw, a Shell Bell, a Scope Lens, a Muscle Band. **"Beat us and keep what we were holding."**

success.text: The first three step out one after another. The Quick Claw, the Shell Bell and the Scope Lens are on the line.

events.name: The Last of the Gauntlet
events.intro: The fourth trainer is the oldest, and holds up the Muscle Band without a word.

success.text: One more.
You have three of the four. The veteran nods: fair enough.

events.name: Hot Dog Duelists
events.intro: Two hot dog vendors, one street corner, one grudge older than either of their carts. They see you and both shout at once: "Settle it!"

success.text: They come at you together, still arguing. Whoever wins, you are told, gets fed.

win.text: Settled the hot dog feud; the feast healed the whole team.

events.name: Lifeguard Test
events.intro: A whistle, shrill and panicked: "A swimmer's in trouble!" Out past the buoys, an arm goes up and goes under.

success.text: Your Pokémon is in the water or in the air before you have finished shouting, and the swimmer is pulled out, coughing and alive. The lifeguard runs up, soaked, grinning: "That was my job! Right. Prove you can do it properly."

win.text: Pulled a swimmer out of the sea.

success.text: You shout until your voice cracks, and the lifeguard hears and goes in, and comes out with the swimmer over one shoulder. She is too busy to battle anyone today.

events.name: Pokémon Marathon
events.intro: Runners line up at a chalk line with their Pokémon, stretching. A banner over the finish says the prize: a Choice Scarf. It is a very long way to the finish.

success.text: You find your rhythm and keep it, mile after mile, your team running beside you, and you cross the line with your lungs on fire. They hang the Choice Scarf round your lead's neck.

failure.text: You lose your rhythm halfway and finish somewhere in the middle, gasping. No scarf. Your team does not care at all: they had a wonderful time.

events.name: Mentor's Examination
events.intro: **A veteran** on a folding chair, an Expert Belt laid across her knees: "No held items. No bag. Just you and them. Pass, and take this."

success.text: Hold items come off. Bag goes on the ground. She stands.

win.text: Passed the veteran's examination with no items.

events.name: Moot Court Showdown
events.intro: **A law student** in a gown two sizes too big: "Out-argue me, and then we enforce the verdict in battle. Every point you win, my lead feels it."

success.text: She clears her throat and asks her first question.

events.name: Moot Court: Question 1
events.intro: "Question one. A Pokémon is put to sleep, and the trainer switches it out. Is it still asleep when it comes back?"

success.text: "...Sustained." She looks at her notes, rattled. Her lead shifts on its feet.
"Overruled!" She looks pleased with herself.

events.name: Moot Court: Question 2
events.intro: "Question two. Does a Ground-type move hit a Pokémon that is holding an Air Balloon?"

choices.label: No, the balloon lifts it clear.

success.text: "...Sustained." She looks at her notes, rattled. Her lead shifts on its feet.
"Overruled!" She looks pleased with herself.

events.name: Moot Court: Question 3
events.intro: "Question three. Your Pokémon has a burn. Is its Attack lower?"

choices.label: Yes, a burn halves physical attacks.

success.text: "...Sustained." She looks at her notes, rattled. Her lead shifts on its feet.
"Overruled!" She looks pleased with herself.

events.name: Moot Court: The Verdict
events.intro: "The court will now enforce its verdict." She sends out her lead. Every point you won, it carries with it.

branches.text: Her lead comes out looking shaken: you won all three points, and it feels every one.
Her lead comes out looking shaken: you won two points, and it feels every one.
Her lead comes out looking shaken: you won one point, and it feels every one.

success.text: Her lead comes out steady. You did not win a single point.

events.name: Pokéathlon
events.intro: A track, hurdles, a crowd in the stands, and a board with the prizes: first place takes a Power Herb; everyone who finishes gets a Potion.

success.text: You and your team clear every hurdle on the beat and cross the line first. The Power Herb is yours.

failure.text: You clip a hurdle, and then another, and finish in the pack. You still get a Potion, and a pat on the back.

events.name: Quiz Master
events.intro: **The Quiz Master**, in a sequined jacket, with a buzzer: "Three questions about Pokémon! Get all three right and a TM is yours!"

success.text: One, two, three. He hits the buzzer three times, delighted, and hands you a TM.

failure.text: You get one wrong. "So close!" He gives you a sticker instead, which is something.

events.name: Relay Battle
events.intro: Three trainers stand along the road with batons, one every hundred paces. Between each, a bench and a water bottle: a breath, no more.

success.text: The first trainer hands you the baton and takes you on. Win, catch your breath, and run on to the next.

events.name: Rookie Hazing
events.intro: Youngsters, five of them, closing in a circle with their caps on backwards. **"Welcome to the road, rookie!"** The last one, at the back, is clutching a Rattata and trying very hard to look tough.

success.text: The first three come at you one after another.
"J-Joey," he says, and goes bright red, and then the others shove him to the back and come at you anyway, three in a row.

events.name: Joey
events.intro: Two left: a big kid, and then Joey, who has stopped trying to look tough and is just holding his Rattata. "It's in the top percentage of Rattata," he tells you seriously. "I checked."

success.text: The big kid, and then Joey, and his top-percentage Rattata.

win.text: Beat Joey and his top-percentage Rattata.

events.name: Speed-Dating Trainers
events.intro: A bell rings. Three tables, three trainers, a sign: "Three minutes per table." Somebody pours you a glass of water.

success.text: Ding. The first one leans across the table. One Pokémon each, and the clock is running.

events.name: Speed Trial
events.intro: **A runner** with a stopwatch and a Quick Claw on a string round her neck: "Beat my time! It's yours if you do."

success.text: You go on her whistle and you go fast, and you beat her by a hair. She takes the Quick Claw off and gives it to you, laughing.

failure.text: You go fast, and she goes faster. "Next time!" She is not even out of breath.

events.name: Boulder Push
events.intro: **A hiker**, sitting on a boulder halfway up a hill: "Push it up the hill. All the way to the top." He pats the boulder. "Nobody's done it this year."

success.text: Your Pokémon sets its shoulder to the boulder and pushes, and pushes, and it rolls, and you push too, and it goes over the top. The hiker gives you his own Black Belt.

failure.text: It goes halfway, wobbles, and rolls all the way back down. The hiker sighs: "Nobody, this year."

success.text: "Nobody, this year," the hiker says again, to the boulder.

events.name: Time Trial Gate
events.intro: A gate across the road, shut, with a quiz board bolted to it and a guard beside it. "Fifteen seconds. Answer it, and through you go."

success.text: You answer with two seconds to spare. The gate swings open.

failure.text: Time's up. The guard sighs and picks up his Poké Ball. "Rules are rules. Battle me, and I'll open it anyway."

events.name: A Trainer's Test
events.intro: **A trainer** with one Pokémon at her side: "One Pokémon. Just one. Win, and I'll teach it something."

success.text: The Pokémon you chose steps forward alone.

events.name: Triple Trouble
events.intro: Three kids at once, shoving each other to be in front: "All of us!" "At the same time!" "That's the rules!"

success.text: Three of them, three of their Pokémon, all at once.

events.name: Trainer Pair of Twins
events.intro: **Amy and Liv**, in identical everything: "We fight as one!" They say it at exactly the same time, and look pleased about it.

success.text: They step out in perfect step.

events.name: Type Specialist
events.intro: A trainer whose whole team, and whose whole outfit, is one type. They have clearly given their life to it.

success.text: One type. Every one of them.

win.text: Beat a type specialist; they went to work at the next Gym.

events.name: Underdog Union
events.intro: Three trainers with the scruffiest Pokémon you have ever seen. **"Each of us carries a rare held item!"** One of them holds up a Wide Lens. "This one's yours if you win."

success.text: They look weak. They are not as weak as they look.

events.name: The Winstrate Family
events.intro: A whole family lines up on their front lawn, from a little boy to a grandmother: "Beat us all, back to back! You're our guest, so we'll look after your team in between."

success.text: The first three, one after another. Between each, the grandmother bustles out with a tray, and your team is fully rested.

events.name: Vicky Winstrate
events.intro: The grandmother takes off her apron and hands her tray to her grandson. "My turn, dear." Your team is rested.

success.text: She is the strongest of them all.

win.text: Beat the whole Winstrate family, back to back.

events.name: The Pawn Berry Smoothie
events.intro: **A smoothie cart**, painted like a Berry: "Blend three Berries into a drink! Good for the next battle only." The menu lists what each blend does.

success.text: A thick blue drink. Your team's Defense is up for the next battle.
A sharp yellow drink. Your team's Attack is up for the next battle.
A sweet pink drink. Your team's Speed is up for the next battle.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Capsule Gacha
events.intro: A toy machine with a crank and a glass dome full of capsules. The odds are printed on the side: 1 in 2 a tiny perk, 1 in 2 a little toy just for fun.

success.text: Crank, crank, clunk. A capsule rolls out and pops open: a tiny perk.

failure.text: Crank, crank, clunk. A capsule rolls out and pops open: a tiny plastic Pokémon. Your lead takes it immediately and will not give it back.

success.text: You give the crank a wistful look and walk on.

events.name: The Final Sale Banner
events.intro: A shop with a banner: "EVERYTHING ₽1." **The owner**, in a cardboard crown: "First, though, a short skit. Store policy."

success.text: It is a play about the region's Legendary, performed by the owner, his wife and a very patient Snorlax. It is terrible, and then, near the end, it is suddenly not: the wife speaks one line so quietly the whole shop leans in, and you know it is true. Then the lights come on. "Everything ₽1! One of each!"
"Philistine!" the owner shouts after you, cheerfully.

events.name: Everything ₽1
events.intro: The shelves: a Potion, a Poké Ball, an Antidote, a Repel. Every one ₽1. One of each per customer.

success.text: You pay ₽4 and walk out with your arms full. The owner bows.
One Potion, ₽1. The owner bows anyway.
"Then the skit was free too!" the owner says, delighted, and bows you out.

events.name: The Gift Wrap Station
events.intro: **A gift-wrap stall** with ribbons in every colour: "Wrap an item for the next person you meet! Someone down the road will get a lovely surprise."

success.text: She wraps it in blue paper with a white bow. "They'll love it."
She wraps it in green paper with a red bow. "They'll love it."
She wraps it in red paper with a gold bow. "They'll love it."
"Another time!" She goes back to her ribbons.

events.name: The Gift Returned
events.intro: **A stranger** waves you down, holding a box wrapped in silver paper: "A friend sent this ahead. They said you'd be passing. They said you sent them something first."

success.text: Inside, wrapped in tissue: something better than what you gave. A note says only, "Thank you. It was a hard week."

effects.text: A stranger you sent a gift to sent one back.

events.name: Key Item Workshop: Bikes
events.intro: **Tinkerer, Bolt**, under a bicycle with only his boots showing: "Parts cost money. Work's free. Bring it here and I'll make it go further."

success.text: He takes your bike apart, puts it back together, and hands it over a gear better than it was.
He swaps half its parts and adds a pop-up wheel. "Further still."
"Bring it back when it squeaks."

events.name: Key Item Workshop: Rods
events.intro: **Tinkerer, Bolt**, at a bench covered in reels: "Same deal for rods. Parts cost money. Work's free."

success.text: New reel, new line. A Good Rod.
New hook, new everything. A Super Rod, that can pull the rare ones.
"The fish will wait."

events.name: Lost Property Office
events.intro: **A clerk** behind a counter piled with boxes: "Lost property. Nobody comes back for these. Have a look, if you like. About one box in five has something worth keeping."

success.text: Under a pile of single gloves you find it: something worth keeping, with a paper tag tied on and a date written in careful pencil.

failure.text: Gloves. Umbrellas. A single roller skate. Nothing you can use, but somebody loved every one of these once.

events.name: The Street Tailor
events.intro: **A tailor** with a mouthful of pins and a tape round her neck: "A new look, and a small perk with it." She holds up three outfits, each with a card pinned on: Sharp Suit, Charisma +1; Trail Gear, Strength +1; Scholar's Coat, Intelligence +1. ₽80 each.

success.text: You look the part. People listen when you talk.
Sturdy boots and a coat that could stop a Tackle.
Deep pockets, for notes, and a neat cut.
"Suit yourself." She laughs at her own joke for a long time.

events.name: Candy Cache
events.intro: Behind a rock, a jar with a lid. Inside, one Rare Candy, and a note in a child's writing: "for whoever needs it."

success.text: You take it. You do need it. Everyone does.

choices.label: Leave it for the next trainer.

success.text: You put the lid back on and set the jar where the next trainer will find it. Somewhere down the road, someone who needs it more is going to have a very good day.
